title: Video resolution is now an explicit choice
summary:
Video resolution became an explicit request choice, while model-catalog failures got easier to spot and less likely to hold up other requests.

Veo, Wan Pro, and P-Video default to 720p; callers choose 1080p with `resolution=1080p`, even when using former 1080p aliases. Seedance Pro accepts 480p, 720p, and 1080p. Unsupported resolutions now return a 400 instead of quietly falling back. The same update adds conditional pricing for Qwen Image editing and long-context requests, with tiers visible in `/models` and Enter’s model catalog.

Enter now shows an error when the model catalog returns unusable data or takes more than 15 seconds to respond. The generation API also stops sharing an in-flight model-registry read across requests, so one cancelled request cannot leave other requests waiting on the same stalled read. These changes improve failure handling; they do not resolve underlying network issues.

Community-model publishing now recognizes an approved contributor by immutable GitHub ID, so a username change does not interrupt their ability to publish.

daily.title: Choose video resolution
daily.text: Use `resolution=1080p` for Veo, Wan Pro, or P-Video; Seedance Pro accepts 480p, 720p, and 1080p. Requests with unsupported resolutions return a 400 rather than silently changing your choice. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
